Gemini Live

Google AI Studio · free tier · ~3 minutes
Gemini Live is Google's free real-time voice API — the same tech Niya uses for Conversation Mode. No credit card, no Cloud Console.
1

Open the AI Studio link and sign in

Tap aistudio.google.com/app/apikey, then sign in with any Google account. You won't be asked for a card.

Troubleshooting

  • Key starts with "AIza" instead of "AQ.Ab" — that's the legacy format Google is phasing out. Delete it and create a fresh one from the same page (see the callout above).
  • In the EEA, UK, or Switzerland — the free tier won't activate without billing enabled under Google's current terms. This is a Google restriction, not a Niya one.
  • Hitting rate limits fast — free tier is intentionally tight (roughly 10 requests/min on Flash). That's Google's limit, not a bug in Niya.

OpenRouter

openrouter.ai · pay-as-you-go · ~3 minutes
OpenRouter gives you access to many models through one key — useful if you want to try more than Gemini. Sign in with whatever's fastest for you.

Open Niya → tap ☰ (top-left) → AI & Model Settings → under Text API, select Set your own → paste your OpenRouter key into API Key. Set API Endpoint URL to https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, and put the model slug you picked (step 8) into Model Name.

9
Also works for Vision API

Same steps, Vision API instead

Everything above — sign up, add credit, create a key, copy it — is identical for Vision API. The only difference is where you paste it in Niya: open AI & Model Settings → scroll to Vision API → select Set your own → paste your OpenRouter key, with the same https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 endpoint — then put a vision-capable model's slug in the Model Name field there instead.

Not every model on OpenRouter accepts images, so filter by vision support on the Discover Models page (step 7) when picking one. A few common vision-capable slugs to try:

  • openai/gpt-5.6-sol
  • google/gemini-2.5-flash
  • anthropic/claude-sonnet-4
  • meta-llama/llama-4-maverick

Troubleshooting

  • "Insufficient credit" error — add balance under Settings → Credits; OpenRouter is prepaid and meters usage per-request.
  • 402 Payment Required — same root cause as above; check your balance before debugging the key itself.
  • Key not recognized — make sure there's no trailing space pasted in from copy, and that the endpoint is exactly https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.
  • Model not responding — some models route through third-party hosts and occasionally rate-limit; pick a different model from the rankings page.
  • Vision requests failing — double-check the chosen model actually supports image input; text-only models will reject or ignore image content.
